g.text: DungeonMasterApp
Torvin joined the session.
Torvin
You find yourself standing on a windswept cliff overlooking a vast, stormy sea.
The sky is overcast with dark clouds, and distant thunder rumbles ominously. To
your east, a jagged coastline stretches towards a rocky promontory that appears
to be the only shelter for miles. Suddenly, a massive ship emerges from the
mists, its sails tattered and blackened by fire. Flames flicker dangerously
along its rigging, and you hear the wails of tortured souls echoing across the
water.
The ship seems to be in distress, struggling against the storm, but it also
appears to be on a collision course with the rocky promontory just ahead. What
do you intend to do?
Your turn.
Torvin: I draw my sword and step into the tavern, scanning the room for trouble.
You draw your sword from its scabbard with a practiced motion and move towards
the entrance of the tavern. The wooden door creaks as you push it open,
revealing a dimly lit interior filled with the clinking of glasses and low
murmur of conversation. A fire crackles in the stone hearth, casting flickering
shadows across the rough-hewn tables and benches.
Suddenly, a group of rowdy sailors brawling in the corner catches your
attention. One has bloodied his nose; another is trying to keep him from
reaching for a nearby stool. Their shouted insults carry a mix of drunken
bravado and desperation. Would you like to intervene, or do you have another
course of action?
Your turn.
W
hat do you do? (/roll 1d20, /chat hello)
